connector.name: Ghost Publisher
connector.registryDescription: Local-first MCP server for safe Ghost posts, Pages, scheduling, images, and publishing.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package ghost-publisher-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the boragkc account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GHOST_ADMIN_API_KEY
env.description: Admin API key from a Ghost custom integration.

env.name: GHOST_API_VERSION
env.description: Ghost Admin API compatibility version; defaults to v5.0.

env.name: GHOST_READ_ONLY
env.description: Set to true to expose only read-only tools; defaults to false.

env.name: GHOST_UPLOAD_ROOTS
env.description: Allowed absolute directories for local image uploads.

env.name: GHOST_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL
env.description: Optional deployment hook called once after a completely successful publish or unpublish batch.

env.name: GHOST_PUBLIC_POST_URL_TEMPLATE
env.description: Optional public post URL containing {slug} for live checks.

env.name: GHOST_PUBLIC_PAGE_URL_TEMPLATE
env.description: Optional public page URL containing {slug} for headless live checks.
